title: The Last Inheritance Revisited
author: Emrys Villalobos
blurb: Freya Vasquez, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
